integrity: The full polynomial, low-weight identities and Perron argument are explicit and reproducible; no claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: All enumerators are for simple labelled circular ladders with n>=4; no general cubic-graph extension is asserted. SymPy verifies an explicit polynomial determinant, and finite graph checks corroborate, but do not prove, all-orders statements. Publication priority remains provisional.
title: Restrained domination of circular ladders: complete polynomial and exponential filtering
